name: Footer
summary: The AhaSlides marketing site footer (Webflow component Footer, built on Relume uui-footer06), matched to the live ahaslides.com: the AhaSlides lockup above five link columns (Features, Resources, Integrations, Pricing, Company), then a grey band with the award badges, eight contact and social icons, the System status link and the DMCA badge, and the copyright line. The columns reflow to three at 991px and below and two at 479px, and the band stacks and centres at 767px and 479px. Framework-free and bound to the shared --aha-* tokens.
highlights: Webflow component Footer (Pattern / Marketing / Footer), matched to the live ahaslides.com at 1440px, 768px and 375px
Five link columns with absolute ahaslides.com links; three of the column headings are links (Features, Integrations, Pricing), as live
Links fade to Vivid Pink on hover over 0.3s; keyboard focus shows the DS focus outline
Reflows to three columns at 991px and below, tighter spacing at 767px, two columns and a smaller lockup at 479px
Award badges (G2 and Training Magazine Network), eight contact and social icons, System status, the DMCA badge and the copyright line sit in a grey band under the columns and stack at 767px
Brand mark is <aha-product-lockup> and every value is an --aha-* token
